name: @visuelconcept/wui-eng-studio
description: Engineering Studio — standalone WinCC OA WebUI page (/eng-studio): device-first, check-in/check-out studio to model DP types, datapoints and their configs (address/alarm/archive/range) from communicating equipment. Address-book-centric imports (OPC UA browse, SimaticML/TIA Openness export, CSV, AI proposal) with a live diff and transactional check-in. Pure domain in @visuelconcept/wui-eng-core; all I/O behind an EngGateway (HTTP /api/eng in the shell, in-memory demo for docs/screenshots).
